option_relations.rationale: Option A describes MIS-C with neurological involvement, which is a broader category that includes acute ischemic stroke as a specific neurological complication. Therefore, it is a supertype of the leaf.
Kawasaki disease is a distinct vasculitis that shares some features with MIS-C but is not directly equivalent to or a subtype/supertype of MIS-C with acute ischemic stroke.
Option C is identical to the provided leaf label, representing the same clinical entity.

COVID-19–associated cerebral vasculitis (ischemic stroke) is a specific manifestation or component of the broader diagnosis of MIS-C with COVID-19 associated acute ischemic stroke. The leaf implies a systemic inflammatory process (MIS-C) leading to the stroke, while option D focuses solely on the vasculitis and stroke aspect. Thus, the leaf is a supertype of option D.
